content.text: Now let me check the data to understand which column represents the reimbursement amount and how to filter for activities that are recorded.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS,
  DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB,
  SUM(FR.PRS_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS FR
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY DPA ON FR.PSE_ACT_SNDS = DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS
GROUP BY DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS, DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY total_reimbursed DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

content.text: I can see that PSE_ACT_SNDS has a code of 0 for "NON RENSEIGNE" (not recorded) which represents care whose executing provider's activity is not recorded. I need to exclude this and get the top 3 activities. Let me verify this is the correct interpretation and get the final answer.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB as activity_name
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS FR
INNER JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY DPA ON FR.PSE_ACT_SNDS = DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS
WHERE FR.PSE_ACT_SNDS != 0  -- Exclude "NON RENSEIGNE"
GROUP BY DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS, DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY SUM(FR.PRS_REM_MNT) DESC
LIMIT 3

WHERE FR.PSE_ACT_SNDS != 0
GROUP BY DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS, DPA.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY SUM(FR.PRS_REM_MNT) DESC
